mo_ta_cong_viec:
OnSky is seeking a hardware engineer responsible for designing, developing, testing and manufacturing of electronic components. A responsible person should have strong interpersonal and communication skills and be comfortable in the global working environment.
Responsibilities
Design and develop (schematic and PCB layout) for IoT products.
Test and debug circuits.
Work with components suppliers to develop products form the prototype stage to mass production.
Prepare documentation and coordinate with manufacturers for PCB/PCBA fabrication.
Manage device production.
Work on wireless, BLE, IoT products.
Work closely with Embedded Developer to support the development of the applications.
yeu_cau:
Your Skills and Experience We Expect
1-2 years experiences in hardware.
Proficiency in design tools such as Altium Designer or Cadence Allegro.
Ability to use 2D and 3D tools for components library management.
Understanding of basic communication protocols: USB, UART, SPI, I2C…
Proficiency in circuit testing, measurement and debugging using instrument such as oscilloscopes, power supplies…
Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, effective panning abilities and attention to detail.
Experience with the full product development lifecycle is an advantage.
Experience with wireless devices (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth...).
Good English communications skills.
Self-motivated, has a strong sense of ownership and is a good team player. Being able to handle multiple tasks at once and work independently with minimal managerial oversight.
Nice to have
Capable of reading and understanding hardware schematics, and interface specifications.
Working knowledge of Power Line Communication.
Working knowledge with IoT (Internet of Things) devices is a big plus.
Working knowledge of WIFI, BLE products.
Time management skills to complete assigned tasks within strict deadlines.
quyen_loi:
Why You'll Love Working Here Why Join Us?
OnSky was founded by Mr. Hung C. Nguyen and a team of Internet of Things (IoT) experts. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor, wireless, powerline communication, adaptive signal processing, and Artificial Intelligence, Mr. Hung Nguyen is a well-known technologist and executive in Silicon Valley, USA.
Holding over 35 patents, Mr. Nguyen desires to transform innovation and passion into practical applications that can serve humanity for the better. OnSky is his latest creation that aims to redefine smart home and security with IoT and Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies.
Competitive benefit
Work in well - equipped and professional IT environment and IT community.
To be trained and instructed by American Specialists in Vietnam as well as in the US and others.
Professional and Flexible Working Environment.
Great Teamwork.
